What is The Founders Pit Stop?

The Founders Pit Stop is a media platform and a set of free tools for people building SaaS. The interviews are with founders running real products, usually small teams, often bootstrapped. They cover what the business actually earns, what it costs to run, which tools are in the stack, and what the founder would do differently. Nothing is sponsored and nobody pays to appear.

Why do founder interviews matter?

Most SaaS advice online is written by people who have never shipped a product, or by founders who only start talking once they have raised money. That leaves a gap. The founders doing the most useful work are usually too busy to write about it, and when they do get interviewed, the numbers are left out. Every interview here asks for the numbers, and most founders give them.

Why does AI visibility matter now?

People used to find software by searching Google and clicking a result. Increasingly they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google's AI Overviews for a recommendation and take the answer without clicking anything. If those tools cannot read your site clearly, or have never seen your product mentioned anywhere credible, you are not in the answer. Ranking on page one no longer guarantees you get found.

How do we help SaaS founders get discovered?

Three ways. The free Visibility Score audits your site across search, AI content and AI recommendations, and tells you the three fixes worth doing first. Being featured in an interview gives you a permanent, citable page that AI tools can read and quote. Visibility Services is the done-for-you version for teams who would rather hand it over.
